_comment: This file contains Firebase web app configuration. The API key is public and safe to expose in client-side code.
_instructions: 2. Select your project → Project Settings → General
3. Scroll to 'Your apps' section and find your Web app (or create one)
4. Copy the apiKey, authDomain, and projectId from the config object
Note: If you don't fill this file, the system will try to auto-detect projectId and authDomain from ServiceAccountKey.json, but you'll still need to provide the apiKey manually.
